messages:
jamal: Quick heads-up — onboarding call with NovaWeights at 2pm PT. We need final redistribution + marketplace SKU language ready before the call. Legal/ops tradeoffs below, cc @ana @matt

ana: Thanks. TL;DR: two recommended licensing paths: (A) permissive open redistrib (very few restrictions), or (B) marketplace-limited (partners can list on marketplaces but cannot redistribute weights outside that channel). Legal prefers (B) for first release because of export/compliance uncertainty.

matt: Ops note — (B) means we host the quantized artifacts and disable raw weight downloads. Also need a small SKS change for marketplace-only licensing flags. Workload impact ~= 1 engineer-day to add the flag + packaging scripts.

sara: Product concern — if we gate downloads, some SI partners will push back; can we offer a Partner Dev SKU that allows SIs to run on-prem under NDA?

ana: Yes but that opens up export/controlled-usage checks and requires an addendum. Recommended flow: marketplace-limited for public listing; partner-on-prem by signed addendum + audit checklist.

olga: Marketing question — announcement cadence? If partner wants simultaneous blog, we need clearance from legal + partner PR by EOD tomorrow. Otherwise we do a soft listing and announce later.

jamal: OK timeline: decision in this thread by 11:30am PT, finalize marketplace blurb by 3pm, PR assets by EOD tomorrow. Can legal provide the short copy for the marketplace listing?

ana: Provided draft for blurb below — short + neutral. Also attaching the redistribution clause snippet.

ana: ```
Marketplace blurb: "NovaWeights (quantized): high-performance open-model weights optimized for inference on Redwood Dedicated and Hosted. Licensed for marketplace hosting. Contact partner for on-prem licensing."

Redistribution clause snippet:
"Redistribution: The Provider grants Redwood the right to host and distribute the Model via authorized marketplaces. Redistribution of model weights, in whole or in part, outside of authorized marketplaces is prohibited unless explicitly authorized in a separate written agreement."
```

matt: That blurb works. Ops will implement the hosting-only flag. eng-galaxy: can you add a quick smoke test to confirm download gating?

eng-galaxy: Yep — will add a CI job to attempt weight download and assert 403 for marketplace listings without addendum. ETA: EOD today.

jamal: @ana, if partner pushes for permissive license, do we have a checklist of approval steps?

ana: We'll escalate: need export-compliance signoff, product risk signoff, and a legal addendum negotiated. Timeline for permissive = ~2 weeks min.

olga: For PR — if we go marketplace-limited we can still do a co-announcement focusing on performance + infra win, avoid redistribution wording. Draft headline: "Redwood + NovaWeights: fast inference with marketplace-hosted quantized weights".

sara: Also flag for Dedicated customers — will we offer a migration path if they want to move to on-prem? Need ops + legal to outline process in the partner FAQ.

matt: Yep. Addendum + audit checklist + contact point. I'll draft the internal checklist and share here.

jamal: Decision: lean market-place limited (B) for initial listing. Actions: @ana finalize clause & blurb (by 11:30am), @matt implement hosting-only flag + checklist, @eng-galaxy add CI gating, @olga assemble co-announcement copy, @sara draft customer FAQ migration path. I'll confirm with Nova before the 2pm call. :thumbsup:

ana: Copy — I'll push the clause to the partner repo and tag legal-bot to record approval.

legal-bot: Documentation: license-approval recorded (ticket #NW-2023-78). Approval type: marketplace-limited. Approver: ana.

jamal: Thanks all — will update after the call.
